description: This file defines classes related to grain bindings in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes `GrainBindings`, representing the bindings for a specific grain type, and `GrainBindingsResolver`, which resolves and caches these bindings based on cluster manifests.

classes.name: GrainBindings
classes.description: Represents the bindings for a particular grain type, including its properties and associated grain type.

classes.name: GrainBindingsResolver
classes.description: Provides resolution and caching of grain bindings based on cluster manifests, supporting retrieval of bindings for specific grain types or all bindings.

methods.name: GrainBindings
methods.description: Constructor initializing grain type and its bindings.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Retrieves the bindings for a specified grain type, resolving from cache or returning empty if not found.

methods.name: GetAllBindings
methods.description: Returns all grain bindings along with their cluster manifest version.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Ensures cache validity based on current cluster manifest and rebuilds the cache if needed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of grain bindings from the cluster manifest, extracting binding properties.
